· Position vs SMA100/200 ($330.91/$432.28): mid-to-long-term trend bearish dominance, confirmed below.
· 52-week position (23.3%) + current price level is high relative to historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (68.1→60.1) + cooling from overbought territory + downward momentum confirmed.
· MACD histogram trajectory (2.7052→-1.1288) + worsening diagnosis + approaching death cross signal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (mid-band $344.16) + band width 18.34% interpreted as appropriate level.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($349.00) + basis (Pivot S1, based on 20-day low).
· Swing resistance ($363.18) + potential for short-term bullish reversal upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Sideways) + trend direction absence interpreted.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.69) + confidence in movement decreased.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation) + wait-and-see conditions specified.
